html: <sherpa-node-stage slot="columns" data-heading="Intake" data-description="Where the rows come in" data-colour="#3b4ccd" data-x="40" data-w="360" data-removable></sherpa-node-stage>
use: For the stages of a workflow on a `sherpa-layout-canvas`: one column each, in its `columns` slot, its bar along the top with its name and its band down the view. Its host writes where it stands and how wide (`data-x`, `data-w`, plane px), its colour, and `data-removable` while it is not the only one; More reports `stage-menu-select` (Edit, Remove). Add stage and Arrange stages are its host's, in the canvas's `columns-end` slot. Arranging (`data-editing`), a drag on the bar reports `stage-drag`, and an arrow key `stage-step`; its host orders the stages. For nodes that belong together anywhere on the canvas, use `sherpa-node-frame`.
